sourceFile: 32. TIU L5S3-01 R Report test find reason NG BAKO high 2025.12.19y_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft has usable source rows but materially misgroups three distinct test contexts into one changed factor.
issues: Changed factor combines machine split, bonding-line change, and sample-standard reset.
Baseline/test conditions are invalidly mixed across unrelated sections.
AWF machine rows are investigation subgroups, not part of old/new bonding-line comparison.
Before/after sample-standard result should be a separate comparison and judged from rates.
Measurement outcome from header/stat extraction is not valid evidence.
correctionPlan: Split into separate changed factors or outcomes for AWF machines, old vs new bonding line, and before vs after sample standard.
Set bonding-line baseline as old Frame/VP and test as new Frame/VP using rows Test!29 and Test!31.
Keep AWF #1-#4 as equipment subgroup metrics with no baseline unless a comparator is present.
Create before/after sample-standard comparison using rows Test!38 and Test!40 and calculate NG-rate improvement.
Remove the header-derived measurement outcome or replace it with valid row-level defect metrics.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist and cover key data, but grouping citations are insufficient until corrected.
